entities.name: Renata Zarazúa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Renata Zarazúa Ruckstuhl is a Mexican professional tennis player. She reached a best singles ranking of world No. 51 on 25 November 2024, and peaked at No. 72 in the doubles rankings on 15 September 2025, the first Mexican woman to break in the top 100 in singles and in doubles.
